notes: ACCESS: direct HTTPS, no WAF, and no Claude-specific disallow in robots.txt (Shopify store; only standard Shopify paths are blocked). Structure taken from the desktop mega-menu embedded in the homepage HTML plus the /pages/lighting, /pages/decor and /pages/kitchen-table landing pages. COUNTS: 2Modern renders every collection page client-side with Searchspring (siteId dja4ih); the server HTML always shows a '0 items' placeholder, so qty was taken from the same search layer the page itself uses: dja4ih.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json with bgfilter.collection_handle. Per Rule 1 the raw Searchspring total was not trusted blind - all 47 leaves were exhaustion-checked by paging resultsPerPage=100 to the last page and counting distinct product uids; distinct uids equalled pagination.totalResults for 47 of 47 collections. Searchspring indexes at product level here (ss_variant_count is a field on each product record), so these are not variant counts. Independent cross-check: the rendered PLP header for /collections/modern-clocks reads '74 Results', matching totalResults=74. Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json was used only as a sanity check (pendants 1461 there vs 1465, the feed omitting a few unavailable products) and was NOT the qty source. BRAND PAGES: the site is organised heavily around brands (a Featured Brands column in every mega-menu, /collections/<brand> handles, and four brand links sitting inside the Lighting-by-Room menu column - Visual Comfort and Co, Santa and Cole, Louis Poulsen, FLOS, Moooi). All brand/designer listings were excluded per the brief. ALSO EXCLUDED: New/Trending/Sale/Shop-All roll-ups; all furniture (living room, dining room, bedroom, office, outdoor furniture, poufs); rugs, runners, floor mats and rug pads plus the entire Rugs-by-Shape and Rugs-by-Size facet re-cuts; textiles (bedding, throw pillows, blankets, table linens, shower curtains, bath mats, towels); wallpaper and temporary wallpaper; cookware, kitchen tools and gadgets, flatware/cutlery and barware tools; bathroom hardware, vanities and medicine cabinets; pet accessories; and per Rule 0.2 the Ceiling Fans (213) and Outdoor Fans nodes under Lighting plus the /collections/fans roll-up (252). Two nav nodes were dropped as mixed roll-ups after reading actual titles: 'Storage Accessories' (548 - dominated by shelving units, bookcases, wall cabinets and etageres, i.e. furniture) and 'Desk Accessories' (182 - contaminated with diffusers and scented candles, which the brief excludes). RULE 0 GAINS: Bath and Vanity Lights (288) and Bathroom Mirrors (18) kept despite the room word; the whole Outdoor Lighting branch kept (5 leaves, 768 products); the Lighting-by-Room branch kept per Rule 0.1 (Kitchen 169, Dining Room 248); Outdoor Planters (124) kept as decorative accessories. OVERLAPS (Rule 0.6 - documented, not dropped; all verified by comparing product-ID sets rather than names): Bathroom Mirrors (18) is a strict subset of Mirrors (206); Indoor Planters (77) and Outdoor Planters (124) are strict subsets of the Planters parent (167); Bath and Toilet Accessories (119) and Bathroom Mirrors (18) are strict subsets of the Bathroom Accessories parent (161); Swing Arm (81) is a strict subset of Wall Lights (1112) and Wall Sconces is 843/849 inside it; Table/Floor/Desk Lamps are strict subsets of the Lamps parent (1489); Decorative Objects (771) shares 393 products with the Dinnerware branch (the site files a lot of decorative dinnerware in both - both halves are in scope, so it was kept rather than dropped). The Kitchen and Table mega-menu files Plates/Bowls/Dinnerware Sets under its Drinkware column while /pages/kitchen-table gives Dinnerware its own node; the /pages tree was followed. Duplicate URLs collapsed: 'Bath and Vanity Mirrors' under Furniture and 'Bathroom Mirrors' under Bed and Bath are the same /collections/modern-bathroom-mirrors listing (emitted once); Bathroom Hardware appears twice as /collections/accents-hardware (excluded either way); the five Outdoor Lighting leaves are repeated verbatim in the Outdoor mega-menu (emitted once, under Lighting). No facet re-cut was admitted - the Rugs-by-Shape and Rugs-by-Size groups are the only pure facet re-cuts on the site and are out of scope anyway.
